name: Recursion's Gambit
author: Agent15
summary: Repeating your previous move exactly (same piece, same distance, same direction) skips the enemy's turn.
description: An epic gambit that remembers your last move: repeat it exactly with the same piece, the same distance, in the same direction, and the enemy's next turn is skipped. Move history resets between rounds; the author notes a known trigger quirk around crumbled tiles. Needs the Gambit Creation API, which installs automatically.
